Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypts files with .ryuk extension, destroys files larger than 2MB by overwriting with random data, demands ransom payment via purchase of a decryptor sold as a Roblox Game Pass using Robux currency, impersonates Ryuk ransomware
Impacted Systems: Windows systems infected by Chaos ransomware variants
Attack Vector: Ransomware infection via unknown distribution method, ransom payment through Roblox Game Pass store
Indicators of Compromise: Roblox user 'iRazormind' selling 'Ryuk Decrypter' Game Pass for 1,499 Robux
Ransom note demanding purchase of Roblox Game Pass decryptor
Use of .ryuk file extension for encrypted files
